articles.title: Ngumoha not in England squad to face Spain
articles.summary: Liverpool teenager Rio Ngumoha is not named in England's matchday squad for Saturday's Nations League opener against Spain.

articles.title: Bellamy support crucial after serious injury - Wales' Burns
articles.summary: Winger Wes Burns hopes to repay Craig Bellamy's support during a long-term injury by making an impact for Wales in the Nations League.
